newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Thursday, with buying interest waning ahead of tomorrow's holiday, traders said.

They said palm olein was quoted at 1,410-15 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,246.61 rupiah/kg exBelawan at a tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan on Wednesday.
"The market was less active in the afternoon," one trader said. "Buyers were winding down ahead of tomorrow's holiday."
The market will be closed on Friday when Moslems celebrate Eid al-Adha, the climax of the pilgrimage to Mecca.
Traders said they expected prices to remain stable next week, despite weaker consumer demand after Eid al-Adha.
"The Malaysian market made good gains in late trading on Thursday, and this should help the local market when it reopens next Monday," one trader said.
He also said improving export prices were also likely to help keep local values steady.
